idea-plugin.name: Chameleon Store Studio
idea-plugin.description:
Visual store asset and marketing screenshot workbench for Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform.

Features:
  • Interactive Screenshot Gallery: Browse rendered marketing assets in authentic store aspect ratios with multi-module, store, device, and locale filters.
  • Instant Jump-to-Source: Double-click any thumbnail to navigate straight to the @StoreScreenshot composable in Kotlin.
  • Simulated Store Product Page: Preview live Google Play and Apple App Store listings with click-to-edit metadata navigation.
  • Interactive Visual Diff: Review visual changes against baselines with a Before/After split curtain and semantic text drift inspection.
  • Store Compliance Explorer: Audit validation warnings and errors with direct remediation hints.
  • Safety-First Publishing: Run dry-runs and deploy directly to Google Play Console and App Store Connect from Gradle.
